description: This file defines the `ImmutableJsonNull` class, which is an immutable implementation of JSON null value within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It provides singleton access and methods to indicate its null nature and to return JSON null representations.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a JSON null value, providing methods to identify its nature and to retrieve corresponding JSON null objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ImmutableJsonNull.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates that this value is null.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a JSON object representation of null.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates that this value is a JSON array representation of null.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representing null via JsonFactory.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns a JSON array representing null via JsonFactory.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on object identity or class type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on JsonNull class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string "null" for this JSON null value.
